name: 40734-peakbatch-8b-4gpu
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3 on ONE a3 node (--gres=gpu:4).
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process engine.
architecture: Dense LlamaForCausalLM, bf16, 8.03B params = 16.1 GB of weights. Rest is in the checkpoint's config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=512, warmup the first 10% by completion, bounded at 4096 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt exactly 512 tokens and output exactly 512, both min = max; the backend sets `ignore_eos=True` whenever `max_tokens` is set. No sampling parameters and no seed, so backend defaults stand.
purpose: A bulk document-rewriting service on four GPUs, 512 users at once sending half-page prompts for half-page answers.
launch:
# The engine's command line at commit 2ae73c758ceed55ad2f70a69b47c8a994fce5662
# (v0.20.1rc0-45-g2ae73c758cee). The interpreter and the hardware seal are in configs/env.yaml,
# which is per-machine and not portable.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 4
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-num-seqs: 500
max-num-batched-tokens: 500
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
max-model-len: 2048

# V1 turns prefix caching ON by default at this commit, so this line is load-bearing: the
# workload is synthetic text drawn fresh per request, with no shared prefix.
enable-prefix-caching: false
